# SnackPack Universe

> SnackPack Studios builds calm, family-friendly Android apps for early learning, classic offline games, and daily positivity — one shared universe of characters, with no third-party ads and no tracking SDKs in any app. 12 apps are live on Google Play; 6 more are in development.

Key facts that apply to every SnackPack app: no third-party ads, no tracking or analytics SDKs, no account required, data stays on the device, and each app has its own named privacy policy. Several live apps offer an optional one-time purchase or Pro upgrade that unlocks extra content — Google Play processes the payment and SnackPack Studios never receives card details. Contact: support@snackpackuniverse.com.

## Live apps (Google Play)

- [SnackPack ABC: Learn to Read](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-1-abcs-alphabet/): Free alphabet and early-reading app for ages 3–7 — 26 letters with character-led stories, mini books, a progress bookshelf. No ads; an optional one-time purchase unlocks the full library. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.abcalphabet
- [SnackPack 123: Learn to Count](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-2-123s-counting/): Free counting and early-numeracy app for ages 3–7 — counting 1–20, number shapes, story-led adventures. No ads; an optional one-time purchase unlocks the full library. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.counting
- [SnackPack Sentences & Spelling](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-3-spelling-sentences/): Free spelling and sentence-building app for young readers — eight mini-games, themed word packs, and a bookshelf of stories. No ads; an optional one-time purchase unlocks the full library. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.sentencesspelling
- [SnackPack Basic Math](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-4-math-arithmetic/): Free arithmetic app for young learners — number bonds, fractions, and story-led practice. No ads; an optional one-time purchase unlocks the full library. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.basicmath
- [Pawsitive Dose](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/pawsitive-dose/): Free daily mood-boost app for adults — a finite daily batch of animal photos, uplifting quotes, and affirmations with no endless feed, no ads, and no account; reminders and Android widgets included. Optional Pro upgrade. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.pawsitivedose
- [Snackpack Brain Games](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-brain-games/): Free offline collection of 24 classics — including Sudoku, Solitaire, FreeCell, Minesweeper, 2048, Word Search, Checkers, Connect 4, Reversi, Mahjong, Kakuro, Euchre, Dominoes, Bowling and Whac-A-Mole — with local stats and streaks, themes, and accessibility options. No ads, no tracking; optional one-time Pro unlock. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.braingames
- [Snackpack Brain Games Vol 2](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-brain-games-vol-2/): A second collection of 23 calm, offline classic games — including Flappy Snacky, Snacky Worm, Table Tennis, Snakes & Ladders, Picross, Thirteen, Asteroid Destroyer, Golf Solitaire, Yahtzee, Ludo, Rummy 500, SnackWords and a themed Crossword. No ads, no tracking. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.braingames2
- [Snackpack Brain Games Vol 3](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-brain-games-vol-3/): A third collection of 24 games headlined by Chess, Chess Puzzles and Chess Openings, alongside Draughts, Backgammon, Gomoku, Spider Solitaire, Sokoban, Battleships, Killer Sudoku, KenKen and a deep set of pen-and-paper logic puzzles (Slitherlink, Nurikabe, Hashi, Masyu, Akari and more). No ads, no tracking. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.braingames3
- [SnackPack Prehistoric Pals](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-11-prehistoric-pals/): Free offline dinosaur learning app — 34 species, daily facts, and a Field Notes journal. No ads. Optional Pro upgrade unlocks the Amber Archive. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.prehistoricpals
- [SnackPack Zoo World](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-12-zoo-world/): Free animal learning adventure — met-animal tracking, badges, mini-games, and a passport-style exhibit feature. No ads, no tracking, no account. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.zooworld
- [SnackPack Garden World](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-13-garden-world/): Free calm nature learning app for ages 6–12 — six connected habitats, plant and bug discovery, Garden Lens close-up photos, Interactive Viewers, and six ecology mini-games. No ads, no tracking. Privacy policy: https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/privacy/snackpack-13-garden-world/. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.gardenworld
- [Badgify](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/badgify/): Free badge and achievement print/share app. No ads. Optional Pro export choices remove watermarks and add PDF export. Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.badgify

## In development

Six more apps are planned or in progress and not yet live: Tales & Trivia, Creative Studio, Mathematics, Earth Science, Shape & Space, and Robot Recipe. [SnackPack Mathematics](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/snackpack-7-mathematics/) has a complete pre-launch preview: 2,790 questions, 645 game rounds, 560 riddles, 86 story books and 168 Math Lab templates for ages 8–12. See [All apps](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/apps/) for details as each ships.

## Read free in your browser

- [Pip Sits](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/read/pip-sits/): A complete six-page first phonics reader from SnackPack ABC & Alphabet, using the letter sounds s, a, t, p, i and n.
- [Ted-E-Bear and the Button Trail](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/read/ted-e-bear-and-the-button-trail/): A complete six-page counting adventure from SnackPack 123 Counting, covering counting, number order and comparisons.
- [Ted-E-Bear's Short-Vowel Kit](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/read/ted-e-bears-short-vowel-kit/): A complete five-page illustrated beginning reader from SnackPack Sentences & Spelling, focused on CVC short-vowel words. No account, ads or download.
- [Free SnackPack bookshelf](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/read/): Complete illustrated stories are added only when their full approved page-art sets are ready.

## Play free in your browser (web arcade)

36 classic games playable instantly at [SnackPack Arcade](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/) — no ads, no sign-in, no download, and most are installable offline as a PWA. A taster for the Brain Games apps above. Selected highlights:

- [Play Sudoku](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/sudoku/): Free browser Sudoku with Easy/Medium/Hard/Expert puzzles (unique solutions), pencil notes, hints and mistake checking that never ends your game. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Solitaire](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/solitaire/): Free browser Klondike Solitaire with Draw 1 and Draw 3 modes, click-to-move, undo, timer and move counter. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Spider Solitaire](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/spider-solitaire/): Free browser Spider Solitaire in 1, 2 and 4 suit, with unlimited undo.
- [Play FreeCell](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/freecell/): Free browser FreeCell running on a solver-verified deal pool — every board is winnable. Supermove capacity, hints, auto-finish, undo/redo.
- [Play TriPeaks Solitaire](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/tripeaks/): Free browser TriPeaks with streak scoring, round-the-corner mode, undo, hints and a daily deal. Runs on a solver-verified pool of 1,200 deals, so every board is winnable — about 28% of random TriPeaks deals are not.
- [Play Pyramid Solitaire](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/pyramid/): Free browser Pyramid — clear a 28-card pyramid by pairing cards that add to 13, Kings alone. Relaxed, Classic and Hard settings for how often the stock may be recycled, plus undo, hints and a daily deal. Deals are shuffled honestly and not all are winnable.
- [Play Checkers](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/checkers/): Free browser Checkers (draughts) vs a computer opponent with three difficulty levels, compulsory captures, multi-jumps and kings. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Mahjong Solitaire](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/mahjong/): Free browser Mahjong Solitaire with a daily puzzle everyone shares.
- [Play Minesweeper](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/minesweeper/): Free browser Minesweeper with flags, a timer, and Beginner/Intermediate/Expert boards; first click always safe. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play 2048](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/2048/): Free browser 2048 — slide and merge tiles to reach 2048; arrow keys or swipe, best score saved locally. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Connect 4](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/connect-4/): Free browser Connect 4 vs a computer opponent with three difficulty levels. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Reversi](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/reversi/): Free browser Reversi / Othello vs a computer opponent with three difficulty levels, legal-move hints, corner-aware AI and pass handling. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Word Search](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/word-search/): Free browser Word Search across themed word lists (Animals, Food, Nature, Space); drag or tap to find words in any of eight directions. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Crossword](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/crossword/): Free browser Crossword with themed packs and a daily puzzle.
- [Play Picross](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/picross/): Free browser Picross (nonogram) with a daily puzzle.
- [Play Kakuro](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/kakuro/): Free browser Kakuro with a daily puzzle.
- [Play Thirteen](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/thirteen/): Free browser Thirteen (Tiến lên) card game vs three computer opponents, with a daily puzzle mode.
- [Play Cascade](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/cascade/): Free browser Cascade — a calm falling-blocks puzzle (the SnackPack take on tetromino stacking) with Normal and Turbo modes, keyboard and touch controls, and saved best score. Includes rules, strategy, and history.
- [Play Flappy Snacky](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/flappy-snacky/): Free browser Flappy Snacky — a one-button tap-to-fly arcade game with Classic, Hard and Night modes and a saved best score. Includes rules, tips, and an about section.
- [Play Snacky Worm](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/snacky-worm/): Free browser Snacky Worm — the classic Snake game with Classic, Zen (wrap) and Speed modes and a saved best score. Includes rules, tips, and an about section.

The full list also includes SnackWords (a daily five-letter word guess), Golf Solitaire, Snakes & Ladders, Memory Match, Table Tennis, Asteroid Destroyer, and nine original soccer and flag games (Goalkeeper Hero, Penalty Shootout, Free Kick Curl, Crossbar Challenge, Header Hero, Dribble Rush, Keepy-Uppy, Soccer Trivia Sprint, Flag Frenzy) — see [SnackPack Arcade](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/) for the complete, current list.

Twelve games have a shared daily puzzle, collected at [SnackPack Daily](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/daily/) — one board per UTC day, the same for every player, with a local streak and a spoiler-free share string. Includes SnackWords, Sudoku, Word Search, FreeCell, Mahjong Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, TriPeaks Solitaire, Golf Solitaire, Memory Match, Thirteen, Minesweeper and Flag Frenzy.

## World Cup 2026 hub

Original SnackPack browser soccer games plus a 2026 tournament tracker (schedule, teams, bracket, predictions), built for the 2026 football summer. The tournament itself has concluded. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to FIFA, the World Cup, any national team, league, or governing body. No ads, no sign-in, no download.

- [World Cup 2026 hub](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/world-cup/): Soccer games plus a record of the 2026 tournament — group tables, knockout bracket, and results.
- [All 48 teams](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/world-cup/teams/): Every team with flags, groups, players to know, and short facts.
- [Flag Frenzy](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/play/flag-frenzy/): Guessing game — find the mystery World Cup 2026 team using confederation, group, points and status clues, with a shareable result.

## Guides

- [Choosing ad-free learning apps for toddlers](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/best-ad-free-apps-for-toddlers/): A 5-point checklist for verifying "no ads" claims, reading the Data safety section, and spotting manipulative design in kids apps.
- [Offline games without ads](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/offline-games-without-ads/): Why most Sudoku/Solitaire apps are ad-funded, how to check before installing, and the airplane-mode test.
- [How to play browser games offline](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/play-browser-games-offline/): How to install a website as an app and keep playing with the connection off.
- [Free Solitaire without ads or sign-up](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/solitaire-without-ads-or-signup/): Why a card game acquired cookie walls and account prompts, and what "winnable deals" actually means.
- [Free Sudoku without ads or a mistake limit](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/sudoku-without-ads-or-mistakes/): Why free Sudoku apps cap you at three mistakes and gate hints behind coins, and what an honestly-graded puzzle looks like.
- [Free Checkers without ads or an account](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/checkers-without-ads-or-signup/): Why free Checkers apps push online matchmaking instead of a simple computer opponent.
- [A daily mood boost without doomscrolling](https://www.snackpackuniverse.com/guides/daily-positivity-without-doomscrolling/): How to redirect the phone reflex toward finite, calm alternatives to engagement-ranked feeds.
